lines: We expect the growth rate of IFP to notably outpace that of growth spend from Q4 2026 onward, a key driver of operating leverage and profitability. • Stock-based compensation expense (“SBC”) grew by $6.1 million, primarily due to multi-year awards granted to our founders and executives in Q1 this year.

We do not expect SBC to be a material driver of YoY expense growth beginning in Q2 2027. • Other insurance expense grew by $5.1 million, primarily due to payment processing fees, premium taxes, and underwriting data costs.
